scope: New isolated source-view A of identified photographed edition and distinct PHG-rendering B. No automatic canonical/human/runtime admission.

entries.label: Shaman · NECA Ultimate2022
entries.sourceEdition: NECA Ultimate Shaman released August2022, licensed Predator2character toy accessory; film appearance of this bone mask not certified
entries.prompt:
Create ONE isolated rigid skull-like mask of the actual NECA Ultimate Shaman2022licensed toy edition, using only the bone skull mask WORN BY THE MAIN FIGURE in the FIRST official catalogue photograph. Preserve its current near-front source view, inclination, proportions and visible asymmetries. The SECOND official scene corroborates the same actual skull mask, not a new view to merge. This accessory is a documented masked-head toy edition; do not claim it is an original film prop or substitute PHG Witch, Feral, a generic human skull, or a different Shaman design.

Keep the complete pale ivory/grey patinated BONE MASK alone: its visibly pointed/angular upper forehead, source incised forehead relief, two large dark orbital openings, recessed triangular nasal opening, narrow cheeks with dark pits, and its actual fixed rows of irregular sculpted teeth/jaw shape. Those teeth belong to the rigid skull-mask sculpture and MUST remain in the exact visible arrangement; do not replace them with living Predator mandibles or add tusks. Preserve source bone-like matt texture, grey/black weathering and the actual outer contour. Preserve only visible sculpted lines, not invented fine engravings or extra cracks. Eye and nasal holes must be empty transparent openings once the wearer is removed, not filled with glowing eyes, flesh or new black solid plates.

EXCLUDE the dark green/brown broad organic cranial cap and the biological horn buds/spiky ridges seen ABOVE/BEHIND the pale skull forehead. That cap belongs to the living head and is not part of the pale rigid bone mask. Also remove all skin, eyes behind the holes, black dreadlocks, dreadlock bands, collar, cloth cloak, body, separate unmasked head, the separate human skull beside it, trophy skull in hand, staff, hands, weapons, all background skull decorations, catalogue objects and white/scene background. Do not use the separate unmasked Predator head or the small loose red-painted human skull as the mask design.

Match the FIRST catalogue photo's subdued ivory/grey bone paint and even soft lighting for A; no added red paint, gold, chrome metal, eye glow or new colourway. No invented back/interior geometry, hidden profiles, hoses, horns or mechanisms. One complete mask only, no grid, duplicate, text, label, floor, support, mannequin, shadow plane or scene. Genuine transparent alpha background; request1254x1254square if supported. Keep the full mask around78–80percent of the largest canvas axis with8–12percent clear margin on every side, no clipped tooth tips and no stretching, rotation or forced new symmetrical frontal camera.

notes: Only the pale rigid skull mask is retained; wearer cap, dreadlocks, inner organic eyes and accessories excluded.
Two orbital apertures/nasal opening and sculpted mask teeth preserve source arrangement.
Source edition and current camera kept; fine pores/cracks not certified exact.

limitations: Primary catalogue sheet2560x2048 and corroborating official scene2048x2560 show the worn mask; its whole frontal sculpture is visible but microdetail remains limited to mask-area pixels.
The dark organic cranial cap/horn buds, dreads and inner eyes are wearer components; the pale mask has genuine skull-like teeth that are hard sculpture.
This masked accessory edition is documented by NECA; no claim that the bone mask is a filmed Predator2prop.
Native visible minimum margin is below requested8–12percent; no edge clipping observed and no crop/resize/raster change performed.

entries.label: Shaman · NECA Ultimate2022

entries.prompt:
Restage the FIRST isolated bone-mask reference as a separate PHG-quality game-prop render B of exactly the SAME NECA Ultimate Shaman2022mask. SECOND and THIRD references are official photographs corroborating its sculpt; do not change to another camera or merge them. Preserve A's complete outer contour, current source-view yaw/pitch/roll, proportions, pointed upper forehead, incised/raised forehead relief, two orbital openings, triangular nasal opening, cheek cavities and actual asymmetrical sculpted tooth/jaw arrangement. Retain the ivory/grey bone-like paint with dark weathered pits and the exact visible source shape.

The orbital and nasal openings must retain genuine transparency; do not fill them with black plates, eyeballs, skin, lights or background. The hard skull-mask teeth belong to this object and remain; do not turn them into biological Predator mandibles, add tusks or alter tooth counts to look more menacing. Do not restore the dark green/brown biological cap, horn buds, hair or neck removed from A. No wearer, dreadlocks, collar, cloak, staff, hands, separate human skull, extra unmasked head or background.

Change only rendering/material staging to the PHG game-prop family: soft neutral upper-left/front key, gentle opposite frontal fill, coherent rough bone-painted/porous surface response, restrained highlights and slightly calmer fine-grain noise while keeping the source weathered sculpture and ivory/grey palette. This is bone-like sculpt/paint, not polished silver metal or chrome. Do not recolor gold/red, invent new cracks, incisions, glyphs, holes, horns, teeth, mechanics or hidden rear/interior surfaces. A is already a complete render; use a subtle light/roughness restage instead of manufacturing new design differences.

ONE complete mask only, true transparent alpha, no text, labels, collage, floor, stand, scene or shadow plane. Request1254x1254square and80percent mask extent on largest axis, with100–125pixels empty margins above/below and no cropped tooth tips. No geometry stretching, recamera, rotation or redesign. This remains an edition-bound licensed-toy adaptation, not certification that this skull mask is a filmed Predator2prop or an exact neutral albedo.

notes: Same isolated skull-mask sculpt, view and bone palette as A.
Two orbital holes/nasal opening remain empty alpha; actual mask teeth retained without restoring organic head.
Only PHG-family light/roughness staging changed; no film-prop or microdetail certification.

This masked accessory edition is documented by NECA; no claim that the bone mask is a filmed Predator2prop.
Native visible minimum margin is below requested8–12percent; no edge clipping observed and no crop/resize/raster change performed.
